description: Java class 'RitaServices' providing payment processing services via the Rita API, including authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit refund operations, with configuration and credit card info handling.

classes.name: RitaServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for credit card authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit refund operations using the Rita API, with configuration and credit card info handling.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization with the Rita API, returning transaction result details.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction via the Rita API.

methods.name: ccVoidRelease
methods.description: Voids or releases a pre-authorization based on configuration.

methods.name: ccVoidRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund by voiding or releasing a pre-authorization.

methods.name: ccCreditRefund
methods.description: Issues a credit refund to the credit card via the Rita API.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Determines whether to perform a void or credit refund based on order terminal status.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Sets credit card details and billing info into the Rita API object.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Creates and configures a RitaApi instance based on properties.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds properties for Rita API configuration from entity properties.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a string with proper scale and rounding.
